terms.comment: Our description, on the pattern of the lexicon’s other machines (māchina lavātōria, the washing machine): nummārius is to do with money, as in Cicero’s thēca nummāria, a money-box (Att. 4.7.2). Traupman, Morgan–Owens and Levi and Bini have no word for it.

phrases.latin: Nummīs opus est; ad māchinam nummāriam eāmus.
phrases.english: We need some cash; let’s go to the cash machine.

sources: Lewis & Short: machina · Lewis & Short: nummarius
